This version moves MZGram from Telegram Desktop 7.2.8 to 7.3.1, with the security fix of 7.2.9: up to 1.0.4 a link that another launch of the app passes on to the running one (a tg:// link opened in a browser, for example) could make MZGram send local files to a chat. Update from 1.0.4 and older. There was no 1.0.5 release: its fixes are in this version.

Windows x64: MZGram for x64 up to 1.0.4 did not start on any computer (`MZGram.exe` needed `libpq.dll`, PostgreSQL's client library, which Windows does not have), so it cannot update itself. Install this version by hand: unpack the zip and run `MZGram.exe`. Windows ARM64 and Linux update from the bar as usual.

On Windows, MZGram now opens tg:// links only when you choose it for them in Settings > Apps > Default apps (or when no other app has them), and leaves Telegram Desktop's links to Telegram Desktop.
